input_policy: Exactly prompt0 and prompt1 in one jobNUMBER root. Require complete official workflow_scored receipts, full generation records, model/software/source identity, actual sidecars/PNG/tensor files, native smoke and kernel smoke. Resolve artifact paths within their task before opening tensor witnesses. No model loading, GPU, scoring, scheduler call or fresh prompt access.
validation: Reuses frozen score and arm validators, rechecks both native endpoint gates from actual saved BF16 tensors, and records comparison residuals. Byte equality is strict; CPU scalar comparisons permit1e-12relative and1e-12absolute drift, while the original1e-3relative-L2 acceptance gate is rechecked without widening.
archive_policy: Refuse existing or noncanonical destination. No output writes until both tasks validate. Copy all28 initial/final tensor witnesses, six PNGs, all14 image/smoke sidecars, completion/scoring/native/kernel/manifest/progress receipts, raw metric JSON/ImageReward CSV, frozen protocol and key provenance notes/source files. retention.json maps original paths to archived paths and hashes. No scratch deletion or source edits. A failure during copying leaves an incomplete archive without archive_complete.json and requires parent inspection before retry.

outputs.report.json: All6 image values for all7 metrics,4 paired intervention-minus-baseline contrasts, descriptive2-caption arm/contrast means, all actual runtime/memory receipts and native recheck residuals. No CI, significance, weighted score, winner, promotion or completed visual judgment.
outputs.retention.json: Byte counts and source-to-archive SHA256 mapping for raw evidence and provenance snapshots.
outputs.archive_complete.json: Written last, hashes report, retention, reviewer manifest and private mapping.
outputs.presentation/reviewer_manifest.json: Condition-hidden common1024 and exact corner crop views, full captions and frozen rows0/1 primary/secondary predicates. Give this plus referenced images to reviewers, not the private mapping or metric report.
outputs.presentation/private_mapping.json: Frozen random.Random(20261018) shuffle of condition-major row0/1 tuples; view01..view06 condition map, withheld until common and detail annotations are frozen.
outputs.presentation/viewNN/common1024.png: Pillow LANCZOS common-scale view made from retained4096RGB PNG, no generative image tool.
outputs.presentation/viewNN/detail1..4.png: Exact1024pixel corner crops at the four frozen boxes, no resizing. Matching boxes need not contain corresponding objects across altered compositions.

runtime_limits: Sequential baseline/fixedmass/unnormalized arm timings include encoding/denoising/endpointclone/VAE and exclude model loading/saving. They are not warmup-matched benchmarks. Unnormalized control adds image-only attention and is not an equal-cost method arm.

coverage: actual frozen native-arm validator with wrong arm/threshold/sigma/source/protocol
one-ULP native receipt drift accepted and recorded; material numeric alteration rejected

execution_boundary: No CR21 GPU output was opened, no real archive was created, no job was launched, no frozen source or protocol was modified, and no commit was made by this unit.
